title: A coverage that is not an object of exactly key, a key pointer, and values, one or more distinct values, is refused at open with schema.invalid naming the keyword
notes: Each schema of package breaks the grammar in one way: an array in place of the object, no values, a third member, a key that is not a string, the empty pointer, a pointer with no leading slash, no value, and two values equal as MTS-DAT-013 compares them, 1 and 1.0. Each is one schema.invalid at the keyword's value, naming coverage. valid holds the edge the grammar allows: values of every type, null, false, 0 and "0" among them, and two arrays of the same items in another order, which are distinct, at a pointer with an escape and an index.
